name: Daily agenda
description: Your day in a few lines: meetings, free gaps, and what needs preparation.
instructions: List today's events on the primary calendar in the user's time zone, in time order, one line each ("10:00–10:30 Weekly sync"). Then add: the longest free gap of the day, any back-to-back stretch longer than two hours, and any event whose description mentions an agenda, a document or a deadline (name it as something to prepare). If there are no events, say the day is free. Only read; never create, move or delete events.
